brief:
Jerusalem Electricity is washing and reinforcing its electrical networks ahead of winter to prevent service disruptions, the Maan Wire reported. The utility company is undertaking comprehensive maintenance measures across its infrastructure in preparation for the harsh weather conditions expected in the coming months.

The preparations involve cleaning network components and strengthening systems to guard against faults triggered by winter storms and severe weather. Company officials are focusing on infrastructure reinforcement to withstand the strain of winter operations and reduce the frequency of outages during the season.

The effort reflects efforts by the utility to maintain reliable power supply throughout the winter period, when demand typically rises and weather-related equipment failures become more common across the region's electrical systems.
title: Jerusalem Electricity readies grid for winter with maintenance push
